text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap garners attention as the<n>Hero from the
Countryside.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek, who will be going up<n>against Oguri
Cap in the autumn<n>Tenno Sho, has become a villain
in the<n>eyes of the public.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Embracing the role, she decides to<n>run the race as
the villain, declaring<n>her intention to defeat Oguri
Cap.
